'''2017 Worlds Day 2 John Veasey LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Veasey]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[John Veasey]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
